name: default
based_on: Zingg's person example, examples/febrl (FebrlExample.py and config.json in the 0.7.0 release): every field FUZZY, labelDataSampleSize 0.5, numPartitions 4; the findTrainingData and label loop from https://docs.zingg.ai/zingg/running-zingg/create-training-data.md, labelling until there are 40 matching pairs, the top of the '30 to 40 matching pairs is a strong starting point' guidance at https://docs.zingg.ai/zingg/running-zingg/create-training-data/label-training-pairs.md
changes_from_doc: the Febrl fields (fname, lname, stNo, add1, add2, city, areacode, state, dob, ssn) become this world's fields: first_name and surname (first and last words of the page title), emails (space-joined), company, city, linkedin and github, all FUZZY as in FebrlExample.py
an id column is added as DONT_USE so output rows map back to pages
the human in the label phase is an oracle answering from the held-out world
proposed_note: none: Zingg Community exposes no match threshold and no review band
